card.name: Names of quoted experts like David
card.fires_on: The first name David (or Darrin/Dave) or its following initial, just before a surname, when a researcher or expert is being named or quoted in news or study text.

modes.label: First name David
modes.description: The name David or Dave itself, right before an expert's surname.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are unrelated and give no clear output effect, though the pole seems to predict a surname next.
card.plain: It lights up on a person's first name, mostly David, when a scientist or doctor is being introduced by name.
